notes.title: Update Information (June 16th, 2021)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40522459/c88837d7cba9466bdb55e7385379fa58bdaacaa5.png

Thank you for playing "EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS".
The following updates have been made.

Update Information：
-For online co-op, the players from different region could be matched with each other from now on.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Update Information (June 8th, 2021)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40522459/c88837d7cba9466bdb55e7385379fa58bdaacaa5.png

Thank you for playing "EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS".
The following updates have been made.

Update Information：
-Fixed issue of Tank and Combat Frame being able to move only forward and backward

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Update Information (June 4th, 2021)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40522459/c88837d7cba9466bdb55e7385379fa58bdaacaa5.png

Thank you for playing "EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS".
The following updates have been made.

Update Information：
-Fixed issue of screen not moving smoothly with slow (minor) movements of the mouse.
-Fixed issue which prevented being able to switch Teammates if you made changes to commands from the Options menu before first playing the game.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Update Information (June 1st, 2021)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40522459/c88837d7cba9466bdb55e7385379fa58bdaacaa5.png

Thank you for playing "EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS".
The following updates have been made.

Update Information：
-Fixed issue of screen not moving smoothly with heavy movement of the mouse
-Fixed issue of screen not moving smoothly with slight movements of the mouse
-Fixed issue of “Mouse Input Sensitivity” not initializing when changed at the Options menu

Thank you for your continued support.
